title_as_printed: Transcranial Direct Current Stimulation for Global Cognition in Mild Cognitive Impairment
blind_first: blind codes were written to this file before the registry codes file was opened

blind_codes.Sample_N: Not reported (narrative review; no count of included studies given)

Task_Type.reason: Narrative review article (labelled 'Review Article') of tDCS for cognition in MCI.

Category.reason: The review synthesises tDCS intervention studies whose evidence is cognitive outcome scores (ACE-R, MMSE, ADAS-Cog) plus safety/adverse events: clinical-trial and neuropsychological data, i.e. C5. tDCS is a stimulation intervention, not an electrophysiological recording (C2 = EEG/MEG/ERP/fNIRS), and the method/intervention does not decide the category. EEG appears only in a half-page Future Directions subsection ('Electroencephalogram (EEG)-tDCS', p. 4) next to PET, fMRI and blood-biomarker subsections, so C2 is marginal at best while the primary domain C5 is missing from the code. C5;C2 would be acceptable; C2 alone is not.
Category.quote: Studies examining the cognitive impacts of tDCS have largely used two specific outcome measures, the Addenbrooke’s Cognitive Examination-Revised (ACE-R) and Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE), as markers of global cognition.

Validation_Type.reason: Narrative review; no predictive model (V2 by convention).

Sample_N_Approx.reason: The review reports no participant total and no count of included studies (68 references, no search/selection reported).
